result.title: SWE-Ladder: Learning to Localize, Reproduce, and Patch via Progressive Privileged Self-Distillation
result.summary: Resolving a repository-level issue typically requires a software-engineering (SWE) agent to localize the faulty code, reproduce the failure, and patch the code. Reinforcement learning trains such agents from a single test result on the final patch, while on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) adds token-level supervision from a teacher with privileged evidence, exposing the full reference patch at every step. Neither provides stage-specific guidance for localization or reproduction. We propose SWE-Ladder, which turns the verified repair of each training instance into stage-specific evidence: the changed files and lines for localization, the fail-to-pass tests for reproduction, and the diff for patching. A rule-based router assigns each step of an end-to-end rollout to a stage based on its tool call, a frozen teacher sees only the matching evidence, and the stages are distilled in repair order while GRPO optimizes the full trajectory. With Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on SWE-bench Verified under the R2E-Gym scaffold, SWE-Ladder improves pass@1 from 9.6% to 16.4%, compared with 10.4% for GRPO and 12.4% for OPSD with the full patch. Under the OpenHands scaffold, it improves pass@1 from 13.0% to 17.6%. Reversing the stage order under R2E-Gym reduces pass@1 to 11.4%.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SWE-Ladder，将已验证的修复拆成定位、复现、打补丁三阶段证据：用基于工具调用的规则路由器把端到端 rollout 的每步归入某阶段，冻结教师仅看到对应阶段证据做自蒸馏，同时用 GRPO 优化整条轨迹。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「步骤按阶段路由、教师只获得匹配的特权证据」的分阶段监督与贡献分配方案，可能可供核查 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的阶段级训练与视觉证据筛选；但该工作为纯文本 SWE 任务，向多模态推理的迁移仍待验证。
